# Support tiers

## Standard support

Standard support is available Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 local business hours.
Initial response target: **1 business day**.

## Priority support

Priority support includes 24×5 coverage and a **4-hour** initial response target.
Priority is included with Enterprise and available as an add-on for Standard.

## Escalation

Security incidents must be reported to security@example.com within **1 hour** of discovery.
Product bugs go through the in-app ticket form; do not use personal email for bug reports.
